set.4.prompt: A sheet of nine fantasy game power icons in a 3 by 3 grid on a plain flat dark grey background, each icon separate and centred in its own cell with generous margin, realistic hand-painted rendering, consistent soft top-left lighting, rich but restrained colours, no text, no frames. Row 1: a golden halo ring with soft radiant light rays; a violet cursed skull wreathed in dark purple flame; an ornate steel longsword with a gold crossguard. Row 2: a crescent moon with drifting dream clouds and tiny stars in blue and violet; a glowing white feather inside golden light; a small brass world globe with painted continents. Row 3: a golden spindle with a glowing silver thread; a golden holy flame; a menacing violet eye in darkness with dark tendrils.
